rule: S_N must not be null
rationale: S_N is the primary identifier and one-to-one join key with Acc_Info_dirty; mandatory field with 0% missing in sample but required for referential integrity

rule: S_N must be unique across all records
rationale: S_N serves as a unique table-level identifier with 30 distinct values across 30 records; duplicates would indicate data corruption

rule: Every S_N in Cust_Bio_dirty must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N
rationale: S_N is defined as a one-to-one shared join key with Acc_Info_dirty; referential integrity must be enforced before joining operations

rule: Account_No must not be null
rationale: Account_No is a business identifier with 0% missing values; required for account linking and deduplication analysis

rule: Account_No must be exactly 4 digits
rationale: Account numbers are 4-digit identifiers ranging from 1001-1028; must be stored as string but currently int64, format must be enforced

rule: Name must not be null
rationale: Name is a mandatory personal identifier with 0% missing values; required for identity verification

rule: Name must be in Title Case format (excluding lowercase particles like bin, binte, s/o, d/o)
rationale: Evidence shows 28/30 values follow Title Case, with one lowercase ('lim wei jie') and one ALL CAPS ('WANG SHI JIE'); standardisation required

check_params.logic: any(w[0].islower() or w.isupper() for w in str(row['Name']).split() if w.lower() not in ('bin','binte','d/o','s/o') and len(w) > 1)

rule: Name particles indicating gender must match the Gender column (Bin/s/o for Male, Binte/d/o for Female)
rationale: Dataset contains Malay names (Bin/Binte) and Indian patronymics (s/o, d/o) that encode gender; inconsistencies indicate data errors

check_params.logic: (re.search(r'\bBin\b', str(row['Name'])) and str(row['Gender']).strip().lower() != 'male') or (re.search(r'\bBinte\b', str(row['Name'])) and str(row['Gender']).strip().lower() != 'female') or (re.search(r'\bs/o\b', str(row['Name'])) and str(row['Gender']).strip().lower() != 'male') or (re.search(r'\bd/o\b', str(row['Name'])) and str(row['Gender']).strip().lower() != 'female')

rule: ID_No must not be null
rationale: National ID is a mandatory identifier with 0% missing values; required for identity verification

rule: ID_No must match Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one letter (S,T,F,G), 7 digits, one uppercase letter
rationale: 93.3% of values conform to standard format (e.g., S1234567D); 6.6% deviate with missing prefix or wrong digit count and require flagging

rule: Race must not be null
rationale: Race is a demographic classification with 0% missing values; required for statistical reporting

rule: Race must be one of the canonical values: Chinese, Indian, Malay
rationale: Evidence shows three semantic categories with casing variations (MALAY, malay, indian); must standardise to Title Case canonical values

rule: Gender must not be null
rationale: Gender is a demographic classification with 0% missing values; required for demographic profiling

rule: Gender must be Male or Female (Title Case)
rationale: Evidence shows four variants (Male, male, Female, FEMALE) representing two categories; standardisation to Title Case required

rule: Age must not be null
rationale: Age is a mandatory demographic field with 0% missing values; required for age verification and service eligibility

rule: Age must be between 0 and 120 inclusive
rationale: Domain constraint for human age; evidence shows values -5 and 4 which are outside realistic bounds for service accounts

rule: Age must be a parseable numeric value
rationale: Evidence shows one non-numeric value 'Twenty-five' that cannot be parsed as a number; must be convertible to numeric

rule: Age must not be negative
rationale: Evidence shows value -5 which is impossible for human age; negative values indicate data entry errors

rule: Age should not be below 13 for service accounts
rationale: Evidence flags ages 4 and -5 as potentially unrealistic for a service account context; requires business clarification

rule: Contact_No must be a valid Singapore phone number (country code 65, 8 digits)
rationale: All phone numbers appear to be Singapore-based with +65 prefix or 8-digit local format; one value has only 7 digits ('8964359') indicating incompleteness

rule: Contact_No must have at least 8 digits (Singapore standard)
rationale: Singapore phone numbers require 8 digits; evidence shows '8964359' with only 7 digits appears to be truncated or incomplete

rule: Email must not be null
rationale: Email is a mandatory contact field with 0% missing values; required for communication

rule: Email must contain exactly one @ symbol with no spaces
rationale: Basic email format validation; evidence shows 13.3% structural defects including missing @, spaces, and double @

rule: Email must not contain spaces or consecutive @ symbols
rationale: Specific structural defects observed: 'zx91 @example.com' (space), 'nabilah@@example.com' (double @), 'not-an-email' and 'useremail.com' (missing @)

check_params.logic: (' ' in str(row['Email'])) or ('@@' in str(row['Email'])) or ('@' not in str(row['Email']))

rule: Country must not be null
rationale: Country is a mandatory geographic field with 0% missing values; required for address validation

rule: Country must use the canonical values: Republic of Singapore, S'pore, SG, Singapore, Singapura, 新加坡
rationale: Evidence shows 8 distinct representations of Singapore (Singapore, SINGAPORE, singapore, SG, S'pore, Singapura, Republic of Singapore, 新加坡); other values indicate errors

rule: Street_Name must not be null
rationale: Street name is a mandatory address component with 0% missing values; required for mailing

rule: Street_Name must be in Title Case format
rationale: Evidence shows one ALL CAPS value 'HOLLAND ROAD' deviating from Title Case standard used by all other entries

check_params.logic: any(w[0].islower() or w.isupper() for w in str(row['Street_Name']).split() if len(w) > 1)

rule: Postal_Code must not be null
rationale: Postal code is a mandatory address component with 0% missing values; required for mail delivery

rule: Postal_Code must be a 6-digit code
rationale: Singapore postal codes are 6 digits; stored as int64 causing truncation of leading zeros (6907, 99999 instead of 006907, 099999); length check validates data integrity

rule: Name in Cust_Bio_dirty must match Full_Name in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N (accounting for case differences)
rationale: S_N is a one-to-one key; sample shows discrepancies like 'Danish Bin Kamaruddin' vs 'Danish' and case differences 'WANG SHI JIE' vs 'Wang Shi Jie' requiring consistency check

check_params.semantic_check: Name should match Full_Name exactly when both are normalised to the same case, or indicate if one is a substring/truncation of the other

rule: ID_No in Cust_Bio_dirty must exactly match ID in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
rationale: S_N is a one-to-one key; sample shows discrepancy S8421753J vs S8421753X for S_N 16, indicating data entry error or identity mismatch that must be flagged

check_params.semantic_check: ID_No must exactly match ID character-for-character
